title: The woven helmet
alt: An ivory motorcycle helmet with woven bamboo panels and a raised clear visor.
description: Material-rich industrial design, including visor hinges, padding and a connected chin strap.
prompt: A striking product-design photograph of a complete motorcycle helmet with a polished ivory shell and a continuous basket-woven bamboo outer accent panel. A transparent visor is hinged symmetrically at the sides and rests half open; a padded dark interior and a coherent chin strap are visible through the opening. The bamboo follows the shell curvature without obstructing the visor. The helmet rests on a dark stone plinth, refined side lighting, no logos or writing.
